metadata.execution_scope: one execution; incoming state is separate
metadata.size: unique instruction nodes on observation-to-output paths
metadata.depth: maximum instruction-node count along a path; zero if disconnected
metadata.paths: operand-edge routes; duplicate operand uses count separately; exact integers
metadata.aggregation: all unions instruction sets, takes max depth, and sums observation path counts
metadata.hypothetical_decoy: enable S6 writes and implicit destination reads; keep ordinary S6 operand reads zero
metadata.limitations: structural dependence, not numeric influence; no value/branch simplification, RNG-stream edges, or inter-program control-flow edges; scalar operations only
metadata.initial_register_dependencies: prior_state when carries_state=1, otherwise per-execution reset values
metadata.register_sources: incoming_value: register at execution entry; written_values: all SSA values written to that register during this execution
metadata.register_targets: final values of all scalar registers in runtime view; final S6 in hypothetical view
metadata.register_size_depth: downstream instruction nodes only; source write is excluded
metadata.register_paths: sum operand-edge paths per source version; shared routes can be counted from multiple versions of the same source register
metadata.register_identity: unchanged source equals final value: size=0, depth=0, paths=1; identity_paths marks that route
